work_identified: Sancti Ephraem Syri Opera Omnia vol. 3 (Syriac/Latin), ed. Assemani, Rome 1743 — one of the Syriac volumes of the six-volume Roman edition, containing: Two Books on Faith Against Inquirers (90 sermons against Arian/Eunomian heresies), Treatise Against the Jews, Necrosima/Funeral Canons (85 metrical compositions), Paraeneses (exhortations to repentance), 23 Additional Sermons (Nativity, Passion, Resurrection, Marian), Treatise on Paradise (15 hymns), and Acts of Saint Ephraem

reasoning: No complete English of Assemani Syriac/Latin vol. 3 exists: saintephrem.org explicitly confirms this. The volume's 7 sections include Necrosima, Paraeneses, Treatise Against Jews, and 90 Faith sermons with no known English. Brock (1990) covers only the 15 Paradise hymns; NPNF is an unrelated selection. First_complete because our vol. 3 is full-volume and only partial prior English of its constituent works exists.
